title: 挑战 5 · 一个按键控制两个 LED
summary: 按下按键，两条并联的 LED 支路同时点亮。
description:
要求：+5V → 按键 → 节点 SWOUT；从 SWOUT 分出两条支路：220Ω + 红色 LED、220Ω + 黄色 LED，都回到 GND。
• 松开按键：两个 LED 都灭；
• 按下按键：两个 LED 都亮。

按键是两条支路共用的“总开关”，所以它要放在分岔点之前。

en.title: Challenge 5 · One button, two LEDs
en.summary: Press the button and two parallel LED branches light up together.
en.description:
Task: +5V → push button → node SWOUT; from SWOUT split into two branches: 220Ω + red LED and 220Ω + yellow LED, both returning to GND.
• Button released: both LEDs off;
• Button pressed: both LEDs on.

The button is the "main switch" shared by both branches, so it has to come before the point where they split.
hints: Put the button across the trench on row e; the column to its right (both the top and bottom halves) is SWOUT.
One lead of each resistor goes into the SWOUT column.
If you use the power module, the bottom bn rail is GND too.
按键横跨凹槽放在 e 行；它右边那一列（上下两段都算）就是 SWOUT。
两个电阻的一只脚都插在 SWOUT 那一列。
用电源模块的话，下方的 bn 轨也是 GND。
